tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_scrape
tool_schemas.description: Scrapes a single absolute URL and returns the extracted content in the requested formats (via formats and/or includeHtml/includeMarkdown/includeText), along with the scrape job metadata and any stored artifacts; if a webhook is provided, we also post the completion event to it when finished. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, formats contains unsupported values, cookies are missing required fields, or timeout/waitFor/priority are not valid integers; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your plan/job limits are exceeded. Raises FETCH_FAILED (upstream/network/timeout), FORBIDDEN (target blocks access), or UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT when the URL cannot be retrieved or parsed into the requested outputs.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to scrape.

formats.description: Content formats to return/store for the scraped page.

onlyMainContent.description: Whether to focus extraction on the primary article/content area.

includeHtml.description: Whether to include raw HTML in the result.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to include Markdown in the result.

includeText.description: Whether to include plain text in the result.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content to load before extraction.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed for fetching/scraping the page.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with the request.

cookies.description: Optional cookies to use when fetching the page.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for the request.

webhook.description: Webhook URL to notify when the scrape completes.

webhookSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign webhook payloads.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values run sooner when queued.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_map
tool_schemas.description: Discovers and returns a de-duplicated list of URLs starting from url using sitemap discovery (includeSitemap) and/or HTML link discovery (includeLinks), applying domain/subdomain rules and pathIncludes/pathExcludes; results are paged with limit and cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more URLs are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is invalid, limit/maxDepth are out of range, cursor is malformed, or includeSitemap/includeLinks are both false; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed map/request limits. Raises FETCH_FAILED when the seed page or sitemap cannot be fetched, and FORBIDDEN when access to the target is denied by the origin.

includeLinks.description: Whether to discover URLs by crawling and extracting HTML links.

limit.description: Maximum number of discovered URLs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for continuing a previous map request.

allowExternalDomains.description: Whether to include URLs outside the starting domain.

includeSubdomains.description: Whether to include subdomains of the starting domain.

pathIncludes.description: Only include URLs whose path matches at least one of these substrings/patterns.

pathExcludes.description: Exclude URLs whose path matches any of these substrings/patterns.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth to follow when includeLinks is enabled.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_crawl
tool_schemas.description: Creates an asynchronous crawl job starting from url and returns a crawl job record (job id/status) that will fetch up to limit pages within maxDepth, applying domain/subdomain and path filters and using scrapeOptions for per-page extraction; if provided, we send progress/completion webhooks signed with webhookSecret. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is invalid, maxDepth/limit/priority are invalid, scrapeOptions contains unsupported values, or webhook is not a valid URL; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when you exceed crawl/job limits. Raises CONFLICT if you attempt to start a crawl that violates account policy constraints (e.g., disallowed external domains settings), and FETCH_FAILED/FORBIDDEN for origin/network failures encountered during crawling.

maxDepth.description: Maximum crawl depth relative to the starting URL.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch in this crawl job.

includeSubdomains.description: Whether to include subdomains of the starting domain.

allowExternalDomains.description: Whether to allow crawling links to external domains.

pathIncludes.description: Only crawl URLs whose path matches at least one of these substrings/patterns.

pathExcludes.description: Do not crawl URLs whose path matches any of these substrings/patterns.

webhook.description: Webhook URL to notify on crawl progress/completion.

webhookSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign webhook payloads.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values run sooner when queued.

formats.description: Content formats to store/return for each crawled page.

onlyMainContent.description: Whether to focus extraction on the primary content area for each page.

includeHtml.description: Whether to include raw HTML for each page.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to include Markdown for each page.

includeText.description: Whether to include plain text for each page.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content to load per page.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed per page fetch/scrape.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send for each page request.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for page requests.

scrapeOptions.description: Scraping configuration applied to each crawled page.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_batch_scrape
tool_schemas.description: Creates an asynchronous batch scrape job for the provided list of absolute urls and returns a job id/status that you can later query for per-URL results; scrapeOptions controls what each item stores/returns, and webhooks are sent on completion when configured. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if urls is empty, contains invalid URLs, or scrapeOptions fields are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the batch size or job limits exceed your plan. Raises CONFLICT if the job cannot be accepted due to account/job policy constraints, and individual items may later be marked failed/skipped when fetch/scrape is not possible.

urls.description: List of absolute URLs to scrape as batch targets.

webhook.description: Webhook URL to notify when the batch completes.

webhookSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign webhook payloads.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values run sooner when queued.

formats.description: Content formats to return/store for each scraped URL.

onlyMainContent.description: Whether to focus extraction on the primary content area.

includeHtml.description: Whether to include raw HTML in the result.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to include Markdown in the result.

includeText.description: Whether to include plain text in the result.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content to load before extraction.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed per URL fetch/scrape.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with each request.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for the batch requests.

scrapeOptions.description: Scraping configuration applied to each URL in the batch.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_check_batch_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current state of a batch scrape job (including per-URL item statuses) and, when includePages is true, includes completed page outputs; results are paged with limit and cursor and can be filtered by item status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jobId does not match the required pattern, limit/cursor are invalid, or status contains unsupported values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when the jobId does not exist or is not accessible to your account.

includePages.description: Whether to include completed page content in the response.

limit.description: Maximum number of job items/pages to return in this call.

status.description: Filter returned job items by item status.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_check_crawl_status
tool_schemas.description: Check the status of a crawl job.

includePages.description: Whether to include completed page content in the response.

limit.description: Maximum number of job items/pages to return in this call.

status.description: Filter returned job items by item status.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_search
tool_schemas.description: Search and retrieve content from web pages with optional scraping. Returns SERP results by default (url, title, description) or full page content when scrapeOptions are provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for continuing a previous search.

language.description: Preferred language code for results (if supported by the search provider).

country.description: Preferred country/region code for results (if supported by the search provider).

formats.description: Content formats to scrape for each search result URL.

onlyMainContent.description: Whether to focus extraction on the primary content area.

includeHtml.description: Whether to include raw HTML in scraped results.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to include Markdown in scraped results.

includeText.description: Whether to include plain text in scraped results.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content to load per result page.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed per result page fetch/scrape.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send for scraping result pages.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for scraping result pages.

scrapeOptions.description: If provided, the server will scrape the resulting URLs and include page content instead of only SERP snippets.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_extract
tool_schemas.description: Extract structured information from web pages using LLM. Supports both cloud AI and self-hosted LLM extraction.

urls.description: List of absolute URLs to extract structured data from.

schema.description: Target JSON schema (or schema-like object) describing the structured fields to extract.

prompt.description: Optional extraction instructions to guide the LLM.

provider.description: Which LLM backend to use for extraction.

model.description: LLM model identifier to use for extraction (provider-specific).

webhook.description: Webhook URL to notify when extraction completes.

webhookSecret.description: Shared secret used to sign webhook payloads.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values run sooner when queued.

formats.description: Content formats to scrape before running extraction.

onlyMainContent.description: Whether to focus scraping on the primary content area before extraction.

includeHtml.description: Whether to include raw HTML for extraction.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to include Markdown for extraction.

includeText.description: Whether to include plain text for extraction.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for dynamic content to load before scraping.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed per URL fetch/scrape.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with each request.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for page fetch/scrape.

scrapeOptions.description: Scraping configuration applied before LLM extraction.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_deep_research
tool_schemas.description: Conduct deep research on a query using web crawling, search, and AI analysis.

query.description: Research question or topic to investigate.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the job.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive asynchronous job status updates.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret used to sign webhook requests.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values may be scheduled sooner.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch/analyze during research.

include_urls.description: Optional list of URLs to prioritize/include as starting sources.

exclude_urls.description: Optional list of URLs to exclude from fetching/analysis.

output_format.description: Desired output format for the research summary.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_generate_llmstxt
tool_schemas.description: Generate standardized LLMs.txt file for a given URL, which provides context about how LLMs should interact with the website.

url.description: Website URL to generate an LLMs.txt file for.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the job.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive asynchronous job status updates.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret used to sign webhook requests.

priority.description: Optional job priority; higher values may be scheduled sooner.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of site pages to inspect when generating LLMs.txt.

respect_robots_txt.description: Whether to respect robots.txt directives while analyzing the site.

output_format.description: Output format for the generated LLMs.txt content.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_check_job_status
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single job by id and returns its current status plus summary metrics (pages_fetched, llm_tokens_used) and any terminal error/result information; refuses UNKNOWN_JOB when the id does not exist in the authenticated workspace and refuses FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or workspace is not active.

includeItems.description: Whether to include aggregated job_items counts by status and kind in the response.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_cancel_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running job by id (transitioning jobs.status to cancelled) and returns the updated job; refuses INVALID_STATE when the job is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired) and refuses UNKNOWN_JOB/FORBIDDEN when not accessible under the authenticated workspace.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded in result_summary.cancel_reason.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_list_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists jobs for the authenticated workspace with filtering by tool/status and cursor pagination; returns an array of job records ordered by created_at desc and a nextCursor when more results are available; refuses FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or workspace is not active.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list call.

createdAfter.description: Only include jobs created after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

createdBefore.description: Only include jobs created before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_list_pages
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored page artifacts for the authenticated workspace with filtering by url/source_job_id/status and cursor pagination; returns page metadata (and optionally content fields) and a nextCursor when more results are available; refuses FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or workspace is not active.

sourceJobId.description: Filter pages by the job that produced them (pages.source_job_id).

url.description: Filter pages by exact canonical URL match.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list call.

includeContent.description: Whether to include content fields (html/text/markdown/metadata/extracted_data/llms_txt) in each page record.

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_get_page
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single page artifact by id from the authenticated workspace and returns its metadata and stored content fields; refuses UNKNOWN_PAGE when the id does not exist in the authenticated workspace and refuses FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or workspace is not active.

includeContent.description: Whether to include stored content fields (html/text/markdown/metadata/extracted_data/llms_txt).

tool_schemas.name: firecrawl_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity inferred from the presented API key, including api_key and workspace metadata, granted scopes, and current month quota usage/limits; refuses FORBIDDEN when the API key is missing, revoked, or its workspace is not active.

includeApiKey.description: Whether to include api key metadata (id, name, key_prefix, status, last_used_at).

includeWorkspace.description: Whether to include workspace metadata and usage/limits.
